# Three.js r95 source reference

The app's unchanged web/vendor/three.min.js exactly matches the official r95
build. This directory includes its official readable distribution, fetched from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r95/build/three.js .
The modular source and build scripts are at https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r95 .
License: web/licenses/Three-r95-MIT.txt.

The readable bundle is supporting source evidence. A pinned independent
minification rebuild has not been demonstrated; the official-catalog recipe
must address that before submission. No engine was upgraded or replaced.
